brief.headline: Binance suffers record $6.3 billion crypto theft
brief.detail: Binance says a security breach affected about $6.3 billion in assets, with roughly $3 billion frozen and losses to be covered.

brief.headline: Reddit shares plunge 30% on weak outlook
brief.detail: Reddit shares sank after weak Q4 sales guidance and a plan to test requiring users to log in to see content.

brief.headline: Nasdaq 100 heads for third correction this year
brief.detail: Investors dumped big tech stocks after disappointing earnings, putting the Nasdaq 100 on course for its third technical correction of 2026.

brief.headline: Anthropic files public S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO
brief.detail: Anthropic has filed a public S-1 for its proposed Nasdaq IPO, a key step toward going public.

brief.headline: Intel stock crashes, erasing $12 billion from government stake
brief.detail: Intel shares crashed as PC sales weaken and AI demand gobbles memory and components, pushing PC prices up; the drop knocked $12 billion off the government's stake.
